target_customer: Small and medium manufacturers in Indonesia buying steel and metal raw materials
problem: SMEs in Indonesia face high prices, minimum order quantities, slow delivery and no inventory visibility when buying steel; Proglix aggregates domestic and imported supply with credit financing.
business_model: B2B marketplace and aggregator (margin on goods) with 30-day credit financing
product_category: B2B steel and raw materials marketplace

founders.name: Wynn Wijaya
founders.background_notes: Seven years in B2B per YC page.

founders.name: Prawira Indrawan
founders.background_notes: 11+ years in software development per YC page.

competitors.name: Juragan Material
competitors.what: B2B construction materials marketplace in Indonesia

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace plus inventory and credit workflows; the hard parts are supply sourcing, logistics and credit risk rather than software.

defensibility.rationale: Supplier relationships and credit could be replicated by other B2B marketplaces; the founders' steel distribution experience helps.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copycat move by an incumbent found through 2026.

market_need_then: Fragmented Indonesian steel supply with minimum order quantities and slow delivery; 500 Global backed it and the company reported 200+ manufacturing plants connected on its site.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and promotional with superlatives ('Indonesia's Top Sourcing Platform')

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive invented name but no press on the brand, mascot or community found; generic B2B tone.

outcome_analysis: Proglix, founded in 2022 by founders with Indonesian steel distribution experience, raised a $1.35M seed in February 2023 led by 500 Global after YC Winter 2023 and was the only Indonesian company in that batch. It is still operating with a Singapore holding company and a reported team of 25, with no later round or exit found, so its outcome so far is growth without a verified follow-on.
notes: Seed amount confirmed by E27 and 500 Global; Seedtable shows 1.4M and CB Insights total $1.85M (a comparison page shows $3.5M); totals unverified. Ralali is named as a competitor in an undated aggregator snippet only, so it is not in the dated list. Bababos coverage (Sept 2023) is after the batch and excluded. Headquarters conflict: Jakarta (YC) vs Tangerang vs Singapore holding company. Confidence is medium-high; founders and competition rest on a single dated competitor. Confidence lowered from high to medium after review: competition rests on a single dated competitor.
